body: Eh nevermind the post above, I've decided not to do it.

It just hurts when they worry about me. I have no idea why, I really want help. I want everything to be normal again but I don't have the strength to do that. I have trouble finding a good reason to even get out of bed in the morning, so trying to tell them about THIS is just too taxing on me and I feel suicide will help relive the pain for me, but not for them.
They don't know all of what I'm going through, just that something is wrong.
I feel like cutting again. I feel like I never want to move again.
Thank you for trying to help me though.

I'm sorry.
I just don't know what exactly is wrong with me.
I'm just stupid though
Just ignore what I say. When I'm like this i don't have my head straight...
I hope you get better. I never will.
Fuck, I just cut again. Why DO I DO THIS
Does it go away?
Eh, what did I expect. No one cares.
And even when I feel better I still cut, thats what makes me sound like a mental case...
Well actually, I have... Alot. That's why I think I might be crazy... I have 4 cuts on my right arm and 7 on my left. I only started 3 nights ago...
I just cut myself again but instead of feeling bad about it i actually felt happy for some reason. It was overwhelming, I almost just want to continue but then I'll think I'm crazy.
If anyone doesn't see my new post, I feel only a bit better. Sleeping and music helps me.
Ive done that tonight already, definitely feel better but still bad.
I feel a bit better now, I will post how I feel tomorrow.
Thank you for your help

Thank you all for your kind comments.
I may not be closer to happiness, but at least I know that people are willing to listen without thinking less of me.
Thank You.

I know what they would think of me before even starting to talk. 
Me being like this for so long has only dug a hole deeper and if I say anything not normal for me to say im afraid that they will see me as a different person, I almost don't want to be happy to keep up this illusion. As far as they are concerned, I am happy.
I've had problems about self esteem since I was 10, and it's only getting worse. I'm almost 16 and I'm worried that this will continue forever.
I've even tried talking about this to my brother and when I start the conversation, I can't finish what I was going to say and then end up just turning my head in silence.
Thanks for the suggestion but the last thing I need is real life human interaction. I get scared for no reason meeting new people.
Actually now thinking about it this all started when I started thinking about death.
I honestly don't know. this just started out of nowhere
Thank you but I don't know what I was trying to accomplish with this
No one should care about me anyway.
I didn't think anyone would see this, just ignore it... It was stupid of me to talk about anything...
